q: 他的外套被雨淋___全湿了。

q: 我的箱子被人拿___别的地方去了。

zh: 去机场的路被大雪封住了。

why: A bare one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence; it needs a result and 了.

zh: 弟弟把我的玩具弄坏了。
py: dì di bǎ wǒ de wán jù nòng huài le
en: My little brother broke my toy.
why: The doer is the subject, so 把 moves the toy before the verb. 被 is not used.

src_py: fēng chuī kāi le mén
py: mén bèi fēng chuī kāi le
en: The door was blown open by the wind.
why: The result 开 stays attached to the verb: 被风吹开了.

src_py: yǒu rén bǎ dēng guān shàng le
task: Rewrite with 被 and 人 (someone).
py: dēng bèi rén guān shàng le
en: The light was switched off by someone.
why: The 把 object goes first, 人 follows 被, and 关上了 is copied. 把 disappears.

s: 我家门口的自行车被偷了。
s_py: wǒ jiā mén kǒu de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le
zh: 我家门口的自行车被偷了。
py: wǒ jiā mén kǒu de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le
en: The bike outside my home was stolen.
why: Correct. After 被 the doer may be dropped, so the verb follows directly, with 了.

zh: 还好，我的钱包没被偷走。
py: hái hǎo wǒ de qián bāo méi bèi tōu zǒu
en: Luckily my wallet wasn't stolen.
why: A past event that did not happen is negated with 没 before 被. 不 is for habits or general statements, and 别 is a warning, so neither fits a plain report.

s_py: chuāng hu bèi gē ge bǎ dǎ kāi le
py: chuāng hu bèi gē ge dǎ kāi le
en: The window was opened by my older brother.
why: When the object is already at the front with 被, 把 is not used for it.

src_py: wǒ de xíng li bèi tōu zǒu le
task: Make it negative: it did not happen.
py: wǒ de xíng li méi bèi tōu zǒu
en: My luggage wasn't stolen.
why: 没 goes before 被 and the final 了 is dropped.

q: 房间已经___收拾好了，你进来吧。
zh: 房间已经收拾好了，你进来吧。
py: fáng jiān yǐ jīng shōu shi hǎo le nǐ jìn lái ba
en: The room is tidied up already, come in.
why: Telling someone the room is ready needs no 被: no doer is named and the result is simply good news.

s: 那个花瓶没被孩子们打碎。
s_py: nà ge huā píng méi bèi hái zi men dǎ suì
zh: 那个花瓶没被孩子们打碎。
py: nà ge huā píng méi bèi hái zi men dǎ suì
en: That vase wasn't smashed by the children.
why: Correct. 没被 with a result verb and no 了 is the mirror of 没把.

zh: 哥哥把我的电脑修好了。
py: gē ge bǎ wǒ de diàn nǎo xiū hǎo le
en: My older brother fixed my computer.
why: The doer 哥哥 is the subject, so 把 brings the computer before the verb. 被 would reverse the roles.

src: 报纸被爷爷拿到房间里去了。
src_py: bào zhǐ bèi yé ye ná dào fáng jiān lǐ qù le
zh: 爷爷把报纸拿到房间里去了。
py: yé ye bǎ bào zhǐ ná dào fáng jiān lǐ qù le
en: Grandpa took the newspaper into his room.
why: Swap the nouns: doer first, 把 + newspaper, and the whole verb tail 拿到房间里去了 stays together.

src: 我的手机被弟弟弄坏了。
src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi dì di nòng huài le
zh: 我的手机已经被弟弟弄坏了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī yǐ jīng bèi dì di nòng huài le
en: My phone has already been broken by my little brother.
why: 已经 goes before 被, never between the doer and the verb.

zh: 我的词典让小王借走了。
py: wǒ de cí diǎn ràng xiǎo wáng jiè zǒu le
en: My dictionary was borrowed by Xiao Wang.
why: Spoken 让 is a passive marker only with a doer right after it. Leaving the doer out (让借走了) is not possible; only 被 can drop it.

py: dàn gāo bèi dì di chī wán le
en: The cake was finished off by my little brother.
why: The cake ended up gone, so the verb takes the result 完. 着 gives an ongoing state, and 过 would be 'has been eaten before'.

src: 邻居的孩子把我们家的窗户打破了。
src_py: lín jū de hái zi bǎ wǒ men jiā de chuāng hu dǎ pò le
zh: 我们家的窗户让邻居的孩子打破了。
py: wǒ men jiā de chuāng hu ràng lín jū de hái zi dǎ pò le
en: Our window was broken by the neighbour's child.
why: The window comes first and the neighbour's child follows 让. 打破了 is unchanged.

py: zuò yè xiě wán le
en: The homework is done.
why: The homework cannot write itself and nothing bad happened, so it is a plain thing + verb + result + 了. 被 is not used.

src_py: dà yǔ bǎ mǎ lù yān mò le
py: mǎ lù bèi dà yǔ yān mò le
en: The road was flooded by the heavy rain.
why: The 把 object moves to the front and the rain follows 被; 淹没了 stays as it is.

s_py: tā huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
py: tā huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
en: He will be criticised by the teacher.
why: Correct. 会 stands before 被, and the two-syllable verb 批评 is fine after a modal.

zh: 放心你的车不会被拖走的。
py: fàng xīn nǐ de chē bù huì bèi tuō zǒu de
en: Don't worry, your car won't be towed away.
why: 不会 goes before 被, and 的 closes the prediction.

src_py: diàn nǎo bèi gē ge xiū hǎo le
task: Say it has not happened yet (还没).
py: diàn nǎo hái méi bèi gē ge xiū hǎo
en: The computer hasn't been fixed by my older brother yet.
why: 还没 goes before 被 and replaces 了.

src_py: nǐ bèi nà ge sī jī piàn le
task: Warn the listener not to let it happen (别).
py: bié bèi nà ge sī jī piàn le
en: Don't let that driver fool you.
why: 别 goes before 被. 你 is dropped in a warning.
